name: Glass Refraction RGBA
description: Raymarched glass with wavelength-correct Cauchy dispersion n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2, so blue refracts hardest as real glass does, plus per-band caustic focusing derived from the convergence of the refracted direction field. Fixes a fake-audio proxy (a variable named audioPulse was actually the mouse button, and plasmaBuffer was bound but never read) and a dead exitT that left Beer-Lambert absorption running over the distance to the surface instead of the path through the glass.

updatedParams.name: Transparency
updatedParams.description: Base transmission of the glass body (maps to zoom_params.x).

updatedParams.name: Dispersion
updatedParams.description: Cauchy B coefficient — the width of the wavelength spread (zoom_params.y).

updatedParams.name: Thickness
updatedParams.description: Beer-Lambert absorption scale over the interior path (zoom_params.z).
